lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately four primary horizontal rows of high-luminance, roughly circular blobs are visible posterior to the gill slits, exhibiting a regular spatial arrangement across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of blobs, creating a grid-like configuration where blobs act as anchor nodes at the intersections.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible along the upper third of the visible flank, showing a distinct luminance gradient with a light superior edge and a shadowed inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The dorsal surface of the primary pectoral fin exhibits a dense, disordered clustering of high-luminance spots, distinct from the more regular grid pattern of the lateral flank.
